newsitem.title: USA: Salant hires new CFO as president/COO leaves.
newsitem.headline: Salant hires new CFO as president/COO leaves.

text.p: Salant Corp said Wednesday that it has named Philip Franzel executive vice-president and chief financial officer.
He replaces Richard Randall, who left the company earlier this year to pursue other opportunities, Salant said.
Franzel was formerly executive vice-president and CFO at Ermenegildo Zegna Corp.
The company also said that Michael Lubin, president and chief operating officer, will be leaving the company on July 31.
His merchandising duties, said the company, have been shifted to chairman and chief executive Jerry Politzer, and his operational responsibilities will be handled by Franzel.

Since April, the company has installed a new chairman and chief executive, a new chief financial officer, and a new president of its menswear division. It also incurred restructuring expenses of $11.7 million in 1996.
Salant markets men's apparel under the Perry Ellis, Manhattan and John Henry labels. It also sells children's sleepwear, underwear and sportswear.
